'''Suba''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] assigned to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. He served as the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] and [[political officer]], responsible for ensuring the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] loyalty of his fellow [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]]. Frequently serving aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] under the command of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]], Suba disapproved of Vader's reluctance to simply [[Death/Legends|kill]] the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], though he did not voice his opinion. Concurrent with the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Hoth campaign]] of 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]], Suba assisted in the investigation of murdered ''Executor'' bridge [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]].

==Biography==
Suba was a [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]]<ref name="Dagobah" /> of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] serving aboard the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']], personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], by<ref name="ESB" /> [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']] to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].</ref> He was the ''Executor''{{'s}} [[Chief of Security/Legends|chief of security]] and [[political officer]], responsible for ensuring that his fellow [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] remained loyal to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Dagobah" /> Suba served under the command of [[Fleet Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Firmus Piett/Legends|Firmus Piett]] after the latter assumed command of Vader's flagship following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of former [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kendal Ozzel/Legends|Kendal Ozzel]], whom Vader had executed as the result of a critical tactical blunder he committed at the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="ESB" />

As the ''Executor'' and the remainder of Vader's [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], the [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial Death Squadron]], chased the fugitive Rebel [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|freighter]], the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], through the [[Hoth asteroid field/Legends|Hoth asteroid field]] in the aftermath of the Hoth battle and subsequently lost the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] once it disappeared from its pursuers near the [[Anoat system/Legends|Anoat system]], Vader executed another [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] officer, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Lorth Needa/Legends|Lorth Needa]], for his incompetence. Suba was present nearby, standing at Piett's side aboard the bridge, when Vader proceeded to order his admiral to deploy the fleet and calculate every possible escape trajectory the ''Millennium Falcon'' may have taken, before issuing a clear warning to Piett that further failure would not be tolerated. Following Piett's relaying order to deploy the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyers]] of Death Squadron, Suba snapped into action to carry out the command.<ref name="ESB" />

Suba was again present aboard the ''Executor''{{'s}} bridge when the Super Star Destroyer failed to intercept the ''Millennium Falcon'' as it escaped from Imperial forces on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Once more Suba flanked Piett as Vader inquired whether or not the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] had been deactivated during its Imperial impounding on Cloud City, as well as the Dark [[Lord/Legends|Lord's]] subsequent command to ready a boarding party with weapons set to [[Stun/Legends|stun]] to capture [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and the remaining Rebels aboard.<ref name="ESB" />

==Personality and traits==
While [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader intended to capture Luke Skywalker in order to turn the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]],<ref name="ESB" /> Suba disapproved of Vader's reluctance to simply kill Skywalker,<ref name="Dagobah" /> although he refrained from voicing his opinion.<ref name="BTM">''[[Star Wars: Behind the Magic]]''</ref> Suba, a [[Human/Legends|Human]], had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], blue [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], and light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Equipment==
Lieutenant Suba wore the standard-issue [[Imperial officer's uniform/Legends|Imperial officer's uniform]] during his service aboard the ''Executor'' in the aftermath of the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Suba first appeared in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], portrayed by an unidentified extra in two scenes flanking Admiral Firmus Piett as the latter speaks with Darth Vader aboard the ''Executor''.<ref name="ESB" /> The character was first identified by name and provided a brief backstory on the [http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Dagobah-Dark/large/lieutenantsuba.gif "Lieutenant Suba" card] as part of the [[April]] [[1997]] ''[[Dagobah Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="Dagobah" /> Suba also makes a brief, indirect appearance, identified only as the ''Executor''{{'s}} "Chief of Security," in the April [[2009]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Murder on the Executor]]''. As that adventure was released outside [[Lucas Licensing]],<ref name="Murder on the Executor">"[[Murder on the Executor|Murder on the ''Executor'']]"</ref> it is non-[[canon]] within the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Unlicensed">{{UnlicensedStatus}}</ref> Below is the presentation of that information, with assumptions of gameplay options occurring as written.

In that adventure, while the ''Executor'' participated in the Battle of [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a simultaneous investigation into the death of [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant Commander/Legends|Lieutenant Commander]] [[Tanith Sorn]] took place aboard the [[Super Star Destroyer/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]]. Sorn had been murdered by a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Spy/Legends|spy]], [[Malkor Trel]], who had infiltrated the ''Executor''{{'s}} crew. In the course of the adventure, the player, as part of the team assigned to investigate the murder, can get Suba to assist them by granting them access to Sorn's personal quarters.<ref name="Murder on the Executor" />
